# Canonical Tag Checker

> Free tool: fetch a URL for real and get a plain-English report on canonical-tag misconfigurations -- conflicting tags, a canonical pointing at a different domain, or a canonical that 404s or is itself marked noindex. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
